# Welcome to Hawkins, Your Source for Quality
# Ingredients, Chemicals, Equipment & Service

Hawkins, Inc. was founded in 1938 and is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company
that formulates, manufactures, distributes and blends products for its Water Treatment, Food &
Health Sciences and Industrial Solutions customers. We create value for our customers through superb
service and support, quality products, and personalized applications. Hawkins can customize chemical
and ingredient products with our toll blending capabilities. We’re a domestic company that can
quickly respond to your needs.

## Hawkins Offers An Extensive Line Of Chemicals And Ingredients
## For A Wide Range Of Industries.

### [About Hawkins][40]

[Customer-First-Commitment-picture of service rep]

**Customer-First Commitment**

Our long-term success has been the result of a relentless drive to deliver for our customers, 365
days of the year. While we serve diverse industries in different business units, our commitment to
putting our customers first is unfailing. From the moment we make contact with a customer or
potential customer, we work to provide the best service possible.

[guy doing toll-blending picture]

**Customized Products**

Hawkins has chemicals available in a large variety of concentrations. We can provide the chemical
concentrations you’re looking for. Multiple packaging options and custom toll blending services are
also available.

[Click To Find Out More About Custom Toll Blending][41]

[truck picture -show delivery network]

**Delivery Network**

From the moment we make contact with a customer or potential customer, we work to provide the best
service possible–whether it’s arranging for a holiday delivery, making arrangements for unusual
products, or simply just delivering on time, every time. The proof? Many of our customers have been
with Hawkins for more than 20 years.

[Hawkins financial performance data screenshot resized for web display]

**Sustainability**

We are committed to being a responsible, sustainable supplier. See how we incorporate this mindset
into our business operations.

[Find Out More About Our Commitment To Sustainability][42]

[Our Mission & Promise picture of delivery truck]

**Our Mission & Promise**

Mission: To supply quality products and innovative solutions with exceptional service.

Customer Promise: We will respond quickly to changing customer needs with a focus on safety,
technical expertise, and responsible care of the environment and of our community.

[Find out more about Hawkins through our company videos][43]

important. That’s why Hawkins has been expanding. Check back often to see if we’ve opened a location
near you!

## OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
## Effective

Olin Corporation (NYSE: OLN) ("Olin") and Huntsman Corporation (NYSE: HUN) ("Huntsman") announced
that on July 13, 2026, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission declared effective the
registration statement on Form S-4 (the "Registration Statement") filed by Olin in connection with
the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

From innovation to impact- see how we’re advancing solutions that power more sustainable products.

## SHOKLESS™ systems for electric vehicle (EV) batteries
## What’s inside matters…

Developed to encapsulate EV battery cells, our portfolio of polyurethane-based SHOKLESS™ systems are
lightweight, shock-resistant, thermally optimized and structurally strong – supporting OEMs and
battery manufacturers as they work to enhance the next generation of batteries powering EVs.

[Find out more][81]

# ingredients industry

[Touching the lives of people everywhere][74] [Our commitments to the wider community][75]

.

### Innovation

As a speciality distributor of chemicals and food ingredients, we’re now a fully integrated,
leading, innovative service provider. With innovation and collaboration at our heart, we believe
anything is possible.
* [Application laboratories][76]
* [Sampling and evaluation][77]
* [REACH compliance management][78]

### Markets

Azelis services fifteen specific markets worldwide, bringing high-quality products, technical
expertise and local service support to each. Our international team is united in its hunger and
humility. Collaborating across 70+ laboratories to be a benchmark for innovation. A focus for
ambitious brands. And a catalyst that helps our customers to solve challenges and improve lives.
* [Life Sciences][80]
* [Industrial Chemicals][81]

The Azelis Customer Portal is a connected experience that inspires you with trends and inspirational
content for your selected markets, linking you to formulations, products, and related documentation.

### Welcome to CABB

# CABB – Your Partner in Fine Chemistry

CABB Group is a leading contract development and manufacturing company (CDMO) for starting
materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates. We specialize in the production of
customized, highly complex molecules for leading companies, particularly in crop sciences, life
sciences and performance materials industry.

[Watch the Video][129]

###### CUSTOM MANUFACTURING SERVICES

## Serving as an extension of your own operations

CABB Group offers fine chemical custom manufacturing services with a focus on complex, multi-step
chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

# CABB – Your Partner in Fine Chemistry

CABB Group is a leading contract development and manufacturing company (CDMO) for starting
materials, active ingredients and advanced intermediates. We specialize in the production of
customized, highly complex molecules for leading companies, particularly in crop sciences, life
sciences and performance materials industry.

[Watch the Video][129]

###### CUSTOM MANUFACTURING SERVICES

## Serving as an extension of your own operations

CABB Group offers fine chemical custom manufacturing services with a focus on complex, multi-step
chemical synthesis. We welcome customers from any industry requiring high-value starting materials,
advanced intermediates and active ingredients.

CABB’s track record of service is built upon a foundation of core competencies in fine chemistry and
unit operations, joined by an experienced leadership team dedicated to achieving customer success.

###### FINE CHEMICALS**
###### **

## Reagents, building blocks and advanced intermediates

CABB offers a select portfolio of fine chemicals, serving as starting materials or intermediates for
a variety of complex synthesis and formulation projects. Customers rely upon our quality and
exacting specifications for multiple downstream applications.

Products are sold on a made-to-order or made-to-demand basis, combining our manufacturing expertise
with those of our collaborative sourcing partners. Customers are welcome to provide forecasts and
delivery schedules for an easy buying experience.

[CDH - Central Drug House (P) Ltd.]

**CDH** has been serving the scientific community with the largest range of Laboratory Fine
Chemicals, Laboratory Reagents & Dehydrated Culture Media since 1981. We insist upon the superior
quality and fastest service to enhance the trust of our valued customers.

**CDH** is presently manufacturing and marketing over 9000 products. The Trust and belief of our
customers make us more responsible in the aspect of quality. Our Quality Control and R & D
departments are equipped with ultra-modern facilities to extract the best of it. We provide Quality
with Quantity to fulfill the growing expectation of our customers.

questions on the internet. In collaboration with our users, we identify unanswered questions,

[contact us][60].

Henan GP Chemicals Co.,Ltd

Henan GP Chemicals Co.,Ltd and it's brother company Henan EME Technology Co.,Ltd and DEXI CHEMICALS
CO.,LIMITED are the professional and comprehensive distributor of chemical products in China. the
company provides business-to-business distribution solutions for industrial and specialty chemicals
globally. With over 1,000 products and a highly diverse supplier base, GP CHEMICALS offers
one-stop-shop solutions to about 2,000 customers in worldwide. GP Chemicals is one of the leading
ketones, acetates, amines, glycol ethers, arylates, tertiary butyl acetate, tetrahydrofuran, TDI,
acetonitrile, N-Methyl pyrrolidone, methyl-1, 3-propanediol(MPO), PTMEG, PBT suppliers and also a
professional such manufacturer in China. Welcome to buy bulk chemical products from us.

GP Chemicals purchases and stores large-scale quantities of industrial and specialty chemicals from
various suppliers. With value-added services such as just-in-time delivery, product mixing,
formulation, repackaging, inventory management, drum return handling as well as technical services,
GP CHEMICALS aims to be the partner of choice for our customers and suppliers.

LyondellBasell reports first quarter 2026 earnings

LyondellBasell Industries (NYSE: LYB) (the "company") announced results for the first quarter 2026.
The company reported net income for the first quarter 2026 of $125 million, or $0.38 per diluted
share. During the quarter, the company recognized $38 million of identified items, net of tax. These
items, which impacted first quarter earnings by $0.11 per share, included non-cash asset
write-downs, costs incurred for transactions and discontinued operations. First quarter 2026 EBITDA
was $568 million, or $615 million excluding identified items.

[

Read more

2025 sustainability report

LyondellBasell (LYB) is a leader in the global chemical industry creating solutions for everyday
sustainable living. Through advanced technology and focused investments, we are working to enable a
circular and low carbon economy. Across all we do, we aim to unlock value for our customers,
investors and society. Our sustainability approach is organized around three interconnected
elements: building on strong foundations, unlocking change and pioneering transformative solutions.

[

Read more

][3]
2025 Annual Report: CEO letter

2025 challenged the entire chemical industry as we navigated what remains one of the longest
downturns on record. Against this backdrop, LYB made deliberate business and financial decisions to
preserve and grow value through the cycle and position the company for long-term success.

[

Read more

][4]

## Element proof – Winter with LYB

Winter brings two sides of everyday life – adventure in the elements and safety at home. LYB
materials make both everyday edge and everyday comfort possible, enabling performance and protection
all season long.

[ Read more ][5]

CEO Peter Vanacker spoke at the 19th edition of the Gulf Petrochemicals and Chemicals Association
(GPCA) Annual Forum held in Manama, Bahrain, Dec. 8-11. 

[

## Purell medical grade polymers expand in North America

The *Purell* portfolio is available in North America. This move represents more than portfolio
expansion — it marks a strategic shift in how LYB supports one of the world’s fastest-growing
healthcare markets.

[ Learn more ][7]

## Henkel and LyondellBasell collaborate on bio-circular raw material solution

LYB and Henkel have partnered to create a renewable-based transparent plastic cage for Henkel’s WC
Frisch/Bref solid toilet rim blocks. Made through injection molding, the cage contains 30%
mechanically recycled plastics and 70% bio-circular raw materials from LYB CirculenRenew portfolio
using a mass balance approach. The collaboration highlights both companies’ commitment to
sustainable packaging innovation.

[ Learn more ][8]

Founded in 1953, Sinopec Shanghai Engineering Co., Ltd. (SSEC) is one of China’s earliest
large-scale comprehensive engineering enterprises specializing in petrochemical, pharmaceutical and
chemical engineering design and EPC (Engineering, Procurement and Construction) contracting
services.SSEC is among the first batch of domestic enterprises awarded the Class A Comprehensive
Engineering Design Qualification by the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development. The company
also holds multiple top-tier Class A qualifications in engineering consulting, pressure vessel
design and pressure pipeline design.Its core business covers seven major sectors: petrochemical
engineering, pharmaceutical chemical engineering, coal and natural gas chemical engineering,
petroleum refining, new energy and advanced materials, oil and gas storage and transportation, as
well as environmental protection and energy conservation.SSEC provides full life-cycle engineering
services, including technology development and licensing, planning consultation, feasibility study,
engineering design, EPC general contracting, project management, commissioning and operation
maintenance, and digital project delivery.SSEC boasts a high-end professional talent team supporting
high-standard engineering construction and technological innovation. The company has 3
national-level design masters and 9 industry masters for petroleum and chemical engineering survey
and design. It also gathers a large number of experts enjoying special government allowances,
outstanding contributors at national and group levels, and winners of the Min Enze Youth Science and
Technology Talent Award.Professional engineering and technical personnel account for more than 90%
of the company’s total workforce, forming a high-quality, professional and innovative talent team
that underpins high-end engineering services and technological breakthroughs.With over 70 years of
development, SSEC adheres to the original mission of delivering high-quality engineering
achievements for national development. The company has undertaken and completed a host of pioneering
and landmark domestic facilities in petrochemical, chemical, pharmaceutical and environmental
protection fields that fill domestic industry gaps.To date, SSEC has accomplished more than 9,700
domestic and overseas engineering projects and won over 770 national, ministerial and
provincial-level awards for excellent engineering consulting, engineering design, EPC contracting
and project management.The enterprise consistently ranks among the top 100 domestic enterprises in
engineering survey and design, project management and EPC contracting turnover. It has obtained
numerous authoritative honors, including National Advanced Engineering Survey and Design Enterprise,
National Innovative Excellent Enterprise, Benchmark Enterprise in the 40th Anniversary of Reform and
Opening Up, and Backbone Enterprise of the Pharmaceutical Industry for the 70th Anniversary of the
Founding of New China.Since the launch of the 14th Five-Year Plan period, SSEC has fully implemented
the new development philosophy and achieved continuous record-high operating performance. The
company obtained Grade A in Sinopec’s Party building assessments for two consecutive years from 2022
to 2023, and achieved Grade A in comprehensive business performance for the first time in 2023. In
the 2024 annual assessment, SSEC attained dual A+ ratings in both Party building and operational
performance, marking a qualitative leap in high-quality and sustainable development.
